page.content:
Broadway house of Hamilton's New York run.

How Richard Rodgers Theatre connects

  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — Hamilton's Broadway run is at the Richard Rodgers Theatre.
  • Location: The Public Theater — The Public Theater run came before the Richard Rodgers transfer.

What is Richard Rodgers Theatre?

The Richard Rodgers Theatre on 46th Street is the Nederlander house where Hamilton opened in August 2015 and became the musical's canonical Broadway address.

Key threads lead to Hamilton (musical) and The Public Theater.
